comment: Falsification of the chart itself: five rows whose measured fact is written down in M/notes/*, with the value the chart must compute. The generator compares and prints PASS/FAIL per row; a FAIL is a bug in the generator or a stale note, never something to edit away. Each entry names the note and what it says.

rows.note: M/notes/txf-fix.md §2: lower_tex() takes the binding's sampler (slot+stride-1) instead of pan_res_handle(0, MALI_DUMMY_SAMPLER_IDX); MALI_COMPILE_VERSION 33; vk/check.sh txf rows are ok. A texelFetch of a combined image sampler must therefore read the real sampler.
M/notes/view-format.md: res_image_view() takes mali_rtfmt_lookup(v->vk.view_format) for a colour target; check.sh view_format v10/v11/v13 ok; merged in #346.
M/notes/route-decision-2.md §C row 2: ours false (x8 caps :925/:937), bridge true (:954); maxCullDistances = 0 in vk/src/mali_physical_device.c:140.
M/notes/route-decision-2.md §C row 1: ours false (x8 caps :891, cmf :879), bridge true (:920); Mali pipeline rejects any GS/tess stage (vk/src/mali_pipeline.c:145).
M/notes/feature-level.md row 10: ours 128 (x8 caps :414, cmf :402, vk/src/mali_physical_device.c:105), the gate in st_extensions.c:1750 wants >= 1024, PanVK reports 1024.
